Crafting the #Jacquemus Chapeau de Fête headpiece from the Le Palmier collection. Featuring the Confetti embroidery technique, the headpiece is crafted from ostrich feather velvet cut into discs. Each element is perforated at its center, mounted on fine feather tips, then individually dyed, bent, and curved by hand, one by one, to move freely with the headpiece.  The technique requires four custom colours: red, blue, yellow, and black, to match the printed fabric. This Confetti embroidery technique is developed by the Parisian featherwork house Maison Février. #MakingOf #HatMaker #Craft #Hat
